title: Restore folder ZIP downloads in the Downloads tree
description:
Astra review of main 3b2c4f5 against SPEC.md.

## Problem and evidence

frontend/src/components/FileNode.vue:107 renders directory names only as expand/collapse buttons, while line 119 restricts download links to files. The remaining archive link is the name of a completed torrent card (frontend/src/components/TorrentItem.vue:19).

Remove a completed torrent card while retaining its download folder, or view an existing folder after server restart: individual files can be downloaded, but the UI offers no action to retrieve the folder as a ZIP despite the working backend endpoint.

The master reference, static/files/template/download-tree.html, links directory names to download/{{ node.$path }} and uses a separate icon for expansion. Confirmed by implementation/reference comparison; browser access was denied during review.

## Expected behavior and acceptance criteria

- Provide an independent folder archive link/action alongside the accessible expand/collapse button.
- Folder ZIP retrieval remains available without an associated torrent card.
- Preserve keyboard expansion, safe URL encoding, and active-download protections.
- Verify the real UI can retrieve and open a valid ZIP containing the expected files, including nested folders and paths needing URL encoding.

## References

SPEC.md §10 step 3 (line 402): folders stream as ZIP archives.
frontend/src/components/FileNode.vue:107–122; frontend/src/components/TorrentItem.vue:19–21.
